properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
TEMUYONOONANGA,
Temuyombanga;
Muli ba Mukama,
Muli ba Yesu.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Kristo muwombeefu,
Alina-ekisa;
Era n'abaana be
Bamufaanane.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Mumujeemerenga,
Ne bw'abakema;
Musabe Mukama
Mube balungi.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Edda mwasuubiza
Nga muli bato;
-Okugaana Ssetaani,
N'amakubo ge.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Muli Bakristaayo
Mulwanyise nnyo
Buli kibi kyonna,
Mube balungi.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Kristo abafuga,
Ye wa mazima;
Era n'abaana be
Bamufaanane.
